summary: Define the aap_job_launch action in a .tf file and add a lifecycle block that triggers it. Example uses aws ~> 6.0 and ansible/aap ~> 1.4.0, an AWS key pair from public_key_path, the latest RHEL-9 AMI (owner 309956199498), a t2.micro instance, a Default organization lookup, a new inventory and the Demo Job Template.
questions: Show a Terraform example that launches an AAP job after creating an EC2 instance
